name: lq1409_sqlite_lock_exit_tempfail_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: lq1409_sqlite_lock_exit_tempfail — n8n-comms-intent-consumer exits 75 (EX_TEMPFAIL) on a sqlite lock it prints, which transient-2 retries. disk-usage-monitor is lock_kind flock and does not print that phrase, so a bare 75 is RUN_SKIPPED_LOCK; its busy exit is 69 (LQ-20261107-1493).
